create_metric_table: create a new metric table with a name and list of column names for logging Inductor kernel metrics
add_row_metric_table: add a row to a registered metric table with a dictionary mapping column names to values
reset_inductor_metrics: reset all Inductor metrics counters including kernel counts, bytes accessed, and node runtimes
purge_old_log_files: purge old CSV metric log files and rewrite headers at the start of a benchmark run
get_enabled_metric_tables: get the set of currently enabled metric tables from the Inductor config
